codingSimpleTermsDesc: Coding is like giving your computer step-by-step instructions. Just like you'd write down a recipe for baking cookies, coders write "recipes" that tell computers what to do.
whatIsSoftwareEngineeringDesc: Software engineers are people who build things on computers, just like builders work on houses, but instead of bricks, they use code. They help create apps, websites, and programs we use every day. It's not just typing code, they also plan, test, and work with others to make sure everything works well.
frontendEngineers: Frontend Engineers – They build what you see and click on, in apps and websites.
backendEngineers: Backend Engineers – They make sure everything works behind the scenes (like saving your data).
mobileEngineers: Mobile Engineers – They build apps for your phone or tablet.
devopsEngineers: DevOps Engineers – They keep apps running fast and smooth online.
dataEngineers: Data Engineers – They help collect and organize information so apps can use it.

ourMissionText: Our mission is to democratize access to high-quality coding education, empowering all K-12 students, particularly Black and Brown children, to develop critical thinking, creativity, and problem-solving skills. We equip students with the real programming skills, and experiences necessary to thrive in a technology-driven world, fostering a love of learning and preparing them for successful futures in diverse fields. We prioritize career readiness, especially for our high school students, providing pathways to in-demand tech careers through hands-on projects, mentorship, and industry connections. We strive to increase diversity within the tech sector by connecting students to internships, apprenticeships, and job opportunities, while cultivating an inclusive and supportive learning environment for all.
ourVisionText: To create a future where every student, regardless of background, has the skills, confidence, and opportunities to thrive in the digital age. We envision a world where coding is as fundamental as literacy, where Black and Brown students are equally represented in high-paying tech careers, and where diversity drives innovation in every industry. Through engaging, accessible education and strategic partnerships, we aim to empower the next generation to lead, create, and shape a more inclusive and equitable future in technology.

parentFaqQ1: How do I create an account for my child?
parentFaqA1: Creating an account is simple! Visit our sign-up page and select 'Parent Account'. Enter your email, create a password, and then add your child's profile. You can add multiple children under one parent account. Each child will have their own personalized learning dashboard.
parentFaqQ2: How can I monitor my child's progress?
parentFaqA2: Log into your parent dashboard to view real-time progress reports. You'll see completed lessons, earned badges, time spent learning, and skill assessments. We also send weekly progress summaries to your email highlighting key achievements and areas for improvement.
parentFaqQ3: How do I reset my child's password?
parentFaqA3: From your parent dashboard, select your child's profile and click 'Account Settings'. Choose 'Reset Password' and enter a new password. For additional security, we recommend using passwords that are easy for children to remember but hard to guess.
parentFaqQ4: How do I encourage my child to practice coding regularly?
parentFaqA4: Consistency is key! Set a regular practice schedule, celebrate achievements with them, and show interest in their projects. Our gamification features including badges, streaks, and leaderboards help motivate young learners. Consider coding together as a family activity!
parentFaqQ5: How do I contact support if I need help?
parentFaqA5: We're here to help! You can reach our support team via live chat (available 9 AM - 6 PM EST), email at support@codealgoacademy.com, or through our Help Center with searchable articles.
teacherFaqQ1: How do I set up a classroom for my students?
teacherFaqA1: Teachers can create a classroom by going to the Teacher Dashboard and clicking 'Create Classroom'. Enter your class name, grade level and click on submit.
teacherFaqQ2: How do I add Students to my classroom?
teacherFaqA2: Teachers can create a classroom by going to the Teacher Dashboard and clicking 'Student'. Then select 'Add Students' and enter student details.
teacherFaqA3: Navigate to the Use the Live class tab to view performance, completed levels, and engagement levels.
teacherFaqQ4: How will my student access the game?
teacherFaqA4: With the Credentials you have Provided. Now, your student can login to their account and choose to customizer their character.
teacherFaqQ5: How do I access curriculum resources?
teacherFaqA5: Navigate to the Resources tab in your teacher dashboard. You'll find lesson plans, worksheets, presentation slides, and assessment rubrics organized by grade level and topic. All materials are aligned with CS education standards.
teacherFaqQ6: How do I generate progress reports for parents?
teacherFaqA6: Go to Reports > Student Progress in your dashboard. Select individual students or entire classes, choose the date range, and click Generate Report. Reports can be exported as PDF or shared directly via email to parents.
teacherFaqQ7: How do I manage student accounts?
teacherFaqA7: In your Classroom Settings, you can add, remove, or edit student profiles. Reset passwords, transfer students between classes, and set individual learning paths. Bulk import is available via CSV for larger classes.
